_howto: Add a book by copying an entry in 'books'. asin = the 10-character Amazon ID (leave "" if not live yet; never guess). youtube = full URL of a read-along/audiobook, or "". cover = path under /img/books/ (600px tall JPG), or "" for a title-only placeholder. note = optional short status line shown when there is no link.
